name: Curse
description: A small pale bone skull at the end of a thin diagonally tilted brown wood wand, with fine scarlet-red droplets falling beneath the skull. Preserve the bone and wood materials; the Fire accent is the red shower, not an orange flame cloud. One skull/wand only, no character. Sequence stippled appearance, fully formed wand and skull, red droplets during middle frames, then wand and shower dissipate.

name: Protection from Fire
description: Two small joined upright orange-red flame lobes with a tight cluster of sharp pale ivory four-point glints across their upper edge. Preserve the original flamelike protective curtain silhouette; not a globe, shield emblem or explosion. Build from sparse sparks, form the twin lobes with small upper glints, then holes appear and it dissipates.

name: Blind
description: A compact irregular cluster of sharp four/eight-point pale star glints with thin spikes, red-orange only in the fine outer rim. Preserve the original star-cluster effect and its changing point positions. No eyeball, mask, flame ball, glow disc, lens flare or character. Tiny initial spark, short clustered star sequence, sparse glints disappear.

name: Berserk
description: Two VERY THIN flowing scarlet ribbon strands curling and folding about a narrow vertical center. Pale pink-white concentrated edge highlights, deep red backs. Retain elegant empty space between red loops and the original ribbons' twisting shape. Not a flame sphere, DNA diagram, rigid icon, thick tube or broad aura. Sparse entrance, a few continuous red curls through middle, taper to fragments then vanish.

name: Fire Shield
description: A small upright heraldic shield with a restrained bronze/steel rim and deep red face, rising thin orange-red flame licks at its two lower sides. Preserve shield shape and concentrated metal highlights. Fire accents remain at edge, do not repaint whole shield bright gold or add characters. Appears from sparse warm motes, holds shield/flames through middle, disperses into sparks.

name: Frenzy
description: A tiny vertical straight steel sword with a muted bronze hilt in front of a compact woven white-grey wind curtain. In later source frames a second parallel sword appears, preserve this source progression. Keep steel silver, hilt restrained bronze; add only a thin red-orange edge to magical strands for Fire identity. No character, no redesigned weapon. Stippled entrance, one sword with fine ribbon curtain, second sword appears late, then whole effect disperses.

name: Misfortune
description: A small upright U-shaped silver-grey horseshoe hovering over two modest dark charcoal smoke curls. Preserve ordinary metallic horseshoe and smoky lower shape, retain dark material; Fire school signaled only by a tiny red-orange shimmer at a few edge pixels. No golden horseshoe, bright flame, explosion, new symbols or particles everywhere. Stippled appearance, horseshoe and lower dark curls, then fade to sparse specks.

name: Slayer
description: A miniature heraldic steel shield with muted bronze border pierced by a long slender diagonal steel sword. A narrow vertical orange-red spark stream falls down the shield face. Preserve the original sword and shield emblem silhouettes; these are spell symbols, not actor equipment. No giant flame cloud or gold recolor. Build emblem, add thin warm sparks during middle, then dissolve emblem and sparks.

name: Inferno
description: A rounded turbulent orange-red flame CLOUD with an irregular pale cream scalloped outer envelope, softly modeled flame volume inside and darker russet pockets. Preserve the source's rounded puffy burst, visibly different from the tighter Fireball: a billowing envelope opening and dissolving. No spiral, pinwheel, radial shockwave, long tail or persistent field. Seed grows into cloud, hot patches roll, holes open, separated warm fragments dissolve. White remains concentrated, never a solid blinding disc.

name: Armageddon
description: A rectangular PATCH OF MANY SEPARATE slender red-orange falling fire streaks, slanting consistently from upper right toward lower left as in source. Thin pale cream hottest centers, dark orange fringes, generous transparent gaps between streaks. Preserve the diagonal fire-rain pattern, not a sphere, mushroom explosion, circular impact, ground cracks or new meteor rocks. Sparse streaks appear, a modest dense middle patch of parallel fiery dashes, then thin back to scattered streaks and empty. The patch stays compact within the central60% of every cell; no streak enters neighboring cells.

name: Land Mine
description: Three source-supported layers in one atlas. ROW1 four APPEARANCE frames: a tiny flat reddish-brown and bronze elliptical mechanical mine rim forms with small pale warm glints; no floor/background. ROW2 four STATIC MINE studies: the same tiny flat elliptical rim, identical position and appearance; only first will be exported as static hold because original idle is one frame. ROWS3–4 eight DETONATION frames: a small upright pale-hot cream flame puff with fine orange/red edge and tiny sharp glints, grows briefly, opens, thins and vanishes. Preserve source circular mine rim and soft narrow puff. No new area ring, crater, smoke blanket or ground cracks. Three roles stay separate, never render mine and puff together in any cell.

name: Fire Wall
description: Three source-supported phases of ONE NARROW upright flame tongue, no ground plane. ROW1 four APPEAR frames: tiny embers become narrow red-orange flame column. ROWS2–3 eight SUSTAINED LOOP frames: same narrow column size/center, warm bright orange modeled interior, red-orange outer tongues; subtle continuous flame ripple, last loops into first. ROW4 four REMOVE frames: column thins to sparse embers then almost empty. Keep slim rounded-top flame tongue, never a wide wall panel, sheet of solid fire, enormous glow or sphere. All phases have same bottom alignment within their own cells; no effects touch other cells.

name: Sacrifice
description: Two separate source-supported manifestations. ROWS1–2 eight PRIMARY frames: a small grey translucent smoky sphere with two bright white curved interlocking inner figure-like echoes, matching source symbolism. Small restrained red-orange accents at perimeter only; preserve grey-white inner form. Appears, shows curved echoes, dissipates. ROWS3–4 eight SECONDARY frames: a small sharp pale-hot starburst/annulus with a clean central hole, warm cream body and orange-red rim, matching the other source. Opens, thins into a few spokes/fragments, then vanishes. No new character, skeleton, corpse, beam linking layers, fireball or gameplay action. Keep both manifestations in separate cells, never combined.
